name: Precarious Pile OLD
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Little Trouble in Big Absalom
description: This dangerously unsteady pile of miscellaneous goods stands 7 feet high and 10 feet wide
disable:
DC 15 Thievery to carefully excavate a path through the wall without upsetting its balance

DC 17 Athletics to hold up any unstable portions

generalAbilities.name: Collapse
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature attempts to climb or remove an object from the wall or the wall suffers a forceful impact

Effect The wall collapses, dealing 2d8 Bludgeoning Damage damage to creatures on it or within 10 feet of it. A creature that succeeds at a DC 18 Reflex Saving Throw save takes half damage and rolls out of the way in a random direction. On a critical success, they take no damage and can choose the direction.
